_meta.anthropic/searchHint: table list rows data scrape json links

description: Turn a table, or a repeated list (search results, product cards, feed items), into JSON rows; or list the links. kind "auto" picks the biggest table, else the biggest repeated list. Scope it with a ref or selector. Pair with browser_scroll untilStable for infinite feeds.

ref.description: Element ref from browser_find or browser_capabilities.

selector.description: CSS selector, if you have no ref.

name: browser_extract
title: Extract data
